name: 06382 · Uncasville, CT
findings: ZIP 06382 (Uncasville) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06382 (Uncasville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06382 (Uncasville) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 14% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 06382 (Uncasville) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 14% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
